WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-88.939219 42.413862, -88.939186 42.415363, -88.940367 42.495018, -88.894547 42.494185, -88.835385 42.492669, -88.819903 42.492357, -88.804014 42.492036, -88.776488 42.491952, -88.765572 42.492076, -88.737146 42.492821, -88.719482 42.493283, -88.707592 42.493595, -88.705981 42.493638, -88.705946 42.414981, -88.705587 42.327889, -88.705654 42.240766, -88.705708 42.237822, -88.705617 42.153569, -88.716339 42.153547, -88.784229 42.153475, -88.822419 42.153435, -88.822451 42.153435, -88.860901 42.153068, -88.939707 42.152329, -88.940418 42.222617, -88.940573 42.237945, -88.94058 42.238676, -88.940586 42.239399, -88.94059 42.240005, -88.940573 42.259215, -88.940526 42.312363, -88.94052 42.319192, -88.94052 42.319649, -88.940326 42.326649, -88.940328 42.327758, -88.940224 42.333727, -88.939219 42.413862))', 4326) AS g
),
cat1 AS (
  SELECT p.id, ST_PointOnSurface(p.geometry::geometry) AS pt
  FROM pois p
  JOIN region r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, r.g)
  WHERE p."amenity" = 'restaurant'
),
cat2 AS (
  SELECT p.id, ST_PointOnSurface(p.geometry::geometry) AS pt
  FROM pois p
  JOIN region r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, r.g)
  WHERE p."leisure" = 'golf_course'
),
avg1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(elev.z) AS avg_elev
  FROM cat1 c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.pt) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.pt)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
),
avg2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(elev.z) AS avg_elev
  FROM cat2 c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.pt) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.pt)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN a1.avg_elev >= a2.avg_elev THEN 'restaurant' ELSE 'golf_course' END AS answer_name,
  a1.avg_elev AS avg_elev_1,
  a2.avg_elev AS avg_elev_2
FROM avg1 a1, avg2 a2
WHERE a1.avg_elev IS NOT NULL AND a2.avg_elev IS NOT NULL;

```sql
WITH boone_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Boone County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
restaurants_in_county AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
    AND ST_Within(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM boone_county))
),
golf_courses_in_county AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE leisure = 'golf_course'
    OR tourism = 'golf_course'
    OR "leisure" = 'golf'
    OR "tourism" = 'golf'
    AND ST_Within(geometry::geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM boone_county))
),
restaurant_elevations AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    ST_Value(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM restaurants_in_county p
  JOIN public.dem_us r
    ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
),
golf_course_elevations AS (
  SELECT
    p.id,
    ST_Value(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM golf_courses_in_county p
  JOIN public.dem_us r
    ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT
  'restaurants' AS category,
  AVG(elevation) AS avg_elevation
FROM restaurant_elevations
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'golf_courses' AS category,
  AVG(elevation) AS avg_elevation
FROM golf_course_elevations
ORDER BY avg_elevation DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
